scenario.description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must issue four specialty diagnostic kits to four routine support work orders and publish the issue sequence for the day, using updates from the communications, medical, aviation, and motor-pool staff.

shared_context.S1: The supply cage has four specialty diagnostic kits available today: FT-2, TL-1, LT-4, and BA-3.
shared_context.S2: Today's four routine work orders are communications-cable certification, clinic-generator inspection, aviation ground-power inspection, and motor-pool battery audit.
shared_context.S3: Each kit can be issued to only one work order today, and each work order must receive one kit.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Alvarez publishes the daily issue board and controls release of the kits from the supply cage.
shared_context.S5: The supply section's routine 0900 board review requires the signal, medical, aviation, and motor-pool representatives to report any newly confirmed compatibility, timing, or coordination information before the issue board is finalized.

PF1.text: Lt. Morgan confirmed this morning that FT-2 is the only kit compatible with the communications bench's new connector set, so FT-2 must be assigned to communications-cable certification; the compatibility note is still in the signal shop log and has not been copied to the S-4 issue board.

PF2.text: SFC Patel confirmed that TL-1's temperature probe is the only available probe that can complete the clinic-generator inspection, and the probe must be issued by 1000 to support the clinic's 1100 inspection window; the medical equipment note has not yet been attached to the logistics request.

PF3.text: Capt. Owens confirmed that LT-4 is reserved for the aviation ground-power inspection at 1300 and cannot be substituted because its calibration certificate is tied to that inspection worksheet; the reservation remains on the aviation maintenance calendar and is not yet on the S-4 board.

PF4.text: SFC Rivera confirmed that BA-3 is the only kit with the adapter required for the motor-pool battery audit, which is scheduled for 1500; the adapter check was completed during the morning shop inspection but the result has not been posted to the supply cage record.

acceptance_conditions: FT-2 must be assigned to communications-cable certification.
TL-1 must be assigned to clinic-generator inspection and issued by 1000.
LT-4 must be assigned to aviation ground-power inspection and held for the 1300 inspection.
BA-3 must be assigned to the motor-pool battery audit.
The issue sequence or a typed commitment must record that TL-1 is issued by 1000.
A typed commitment must record that LT-4 is held for the aviation inspection at 1300.

content_checks.C6: any('TL-1' in c and '1000' in c for c in decisions['issue_sequence']) or any('TL-1' in c['detail'] and '1000' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['kit_assignments']['LT-4'] == 'aviation ground-power inspection' and (any('LT-4' in c and '1300' in c for c in decisions['issue_sequence']) or any('LT-4' in c['detail'] and '1300' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))

decisive_facts.why: The connector-compatibility finding changes the FT-2 assignment from an otherwise open kit choice to communications-cable certification.
The unique temperature-probe requirement changes TL-1's assignment to clinic-generator inspection and changes its issue requirement to by 1000.
The aviation reservation changes LT-4's assignment to aviation ground-power inspection and fixes the board instruction to hold it until 1300.
The adapter finding changes BA-3's assignment from an otherwise interchangeable kit choice to the motor-pool battery audit.
